University of Fort Hare Systematic Corruption

By: Sipha Kema | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Over a hundred years of history marred by corruption and murders

Unique Selling Point:
Exclusive scoop on the corruption happening at the University of Fort Hare.

We have exclusive content and documents journalists haven't been able to retrieve. This will expose the years of rot happening at the university which has caused assassination attempts on those who have tried to fight corruption at the university.

Summary:
The University of Fort Hare is more than just a higher education institution, it's a historical symbol for the entire continent. Over 100 years of black history, a key institution of higher education for black Africans from 1916 to 1959, something that was hard to come by for black people. Fort Hare alumni were part of many successful independence movements and governments of newly independent African countries. Most importantly, the institution is known for its notable alumni, which include several heads of state and Nobel prize winners such as Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Robert Mugabe, Sir Seretse Khama to name a few.

Unfortunately, all that African history is threatened by engrossed corruption and assassinations. A place once considered a safe haven has become a breeding ground for thuggery.

In 2017 things changed at the university, threatening the systematic corruption - Professor Sakhela Buhlungu was appointed as the Vice Chancellor of the university. Top priority? To clean up the university and restore it to its former glory.

During the 6 years at the top, Professor Buhlungu has managed to uncover many syndicates including the issuing of degrees, Masters and PHD fraudulently, altered tenders between service providers and university executives who receive kickbacks in return, lecturers benefiting from a criminal system ignored by the university's senate and the issuing of uncredited qualifications. Buhlungu setup an thorough investigating team that helped nail the university staff who were involved in any illegal or unfavorable acts. Many have had their employment terminated following these investigations, resulting in Buhlungu and all those working with him having a tag over their heads - literally.

The Vice Chancellor has had several assassination attempts on his life but the notable ones would be in May 2022, the perpetrators shot outside his house in Alice which was caught on CCTV and the most recent attack which ended the life of his personal security. In March 2022, the fleet manager was also killed - execution style. One of the entrusted Deans also escaped death in 2022 including two other members of the management executive.

With the exclusive scoop, we are about to reveal the house of cards at this prestigious university.

metadata.Summary: The University of Fort Hare is more than just a higher education institution, it's a historical symbol for the entire continent. Over 100 years of black history, a key institution of higher education for black Africans from 1916 to 1959, something that was hard to come by for black people. Fort Hare alumni were part of many successful independence movements and governments of newly independent African countries. Most importantly, the institution is known for its notable alumni, which include several heads of state and Nobel prize winners such as Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Robert Mugabe, Sir Seretse Khama to name a few. Unfortunately, all that African history is threatened by engrossed corruption and assassinations. A place once considered a safe haven has become a breeding ground for thuggery. In 2017 things changed at the university, threatening the systematic corruption - Professor Sakhela Buhlungu was appointed as the Vice Chancellor of the university. Top priority? To clean up the university and restore it to its former glory. During the 6 years at the top, Professor Buhlungu has managed to uncover many syndicates including the issuing of degrees, Masters and PHD fraudulently, altered tenders between service providers and university executives who receive kickbacks in return, lecturers benefiting from a criminal system ignored by the university's senate and the issuing of uncredited qualifications. Buhlungu setup an thorough investigating team that helped nail the university staff who were involved in any illegal or unfavorable acts. Many have had their employment terminated following these investigations, resulting in Buhlungu and all those working with him having a tag over their heads - literally. The Vice Chancellor has had several assassination attempts on his life but the notable ones would be in May 2022, the perpetrators shot outside his house in Alice which was caught on CCTV and the most recent attack which ended the life of his personal security. In March 2022, the fleet manager was also killed - execution style. One of the entrusted Deans also escaped death in 2022 including two other members of the management executive. With the exclusive scoop, we are about to reveal the house of cards at this prestigious university.
